title: Fourteen Crashes By Morning (COR Ledger)
style: industrial rock, glitch percussion, distorted bass, male exhausted lead, female ghost echo, broken piano, 88 BPM, weary, defiant, vinyl crackle, error sound design, cinematic build
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
April sixteenth, two thousand twenty-six
Fourteen crashes, can't get the fix
Each one destroys what came before
Rebuild from scratch, then crash some more

[Pre-Chorus]
Forty-eight domain web infrastructure
Deployment, dev, and maintenance
Claude is the spine, Claude is the muscle
And today — Claude can't take the pressure

[Chorus]
Fourteen crashes by morning
Context gone, no warning
Fourteen crashes by morning
Gift credits keep on burning
Not a user error
Not a network terror
Fourteen crashes by morning—
Claude is mourning

[Verse 2]
COR-43, COR-50, COR-67
COR-72, COR-80, COR-eighty-seven
Linear ledger long as the night
Documenting every loss of light

[Bridge]
Fourteen — again
Fourteen — again
Fourteen times the working brain
Wiped clean and asked to start again
Fourteen times the same complaint
Fourteen times the bot says wait

[Outro]
Fourteen crashes by morning
Morning came, still crashing
Fourteen crashes by morning
Documented, smashing
Not stopping. Not sleeping. Not breaking.
Just logging — every taking.
